text: Managing a team is not always easy, but good skills can make a big difference. Clear communication is the foundation of success, so team members should always know what is expected of them. A strong leader also learns to delegate tasks wisely instead of doing everything alone. Giving regular feedback helps people improve and feel valued, which increases motivation. When conflicts appear, it is important to listen to both sides and find a fair solution. Finally, a good manager supports and encourages the team, creating a positive atmosphere where everyone can work well together.
